sprint_target.description: Narrative + Hypothesis + Prediction accuracy must be >= 80%

details.title: 2022 Inflation Peak — CPI Hits 8.5%
details.expected_narrative: Inflation Crisis — 40-year high CPI forcing aggressive Fed tightening cycle
details.actual_outcome: CPI peaked June 2022 at 9.1%. Fed hiked 75bp four consecutive times. S&P bottomed October 2022.

details.title: Peak Inflation Narrative Emerges
details.expected_narrative: Peak Inflation — CPI moderating, market pricing in pivot hopes
expected_hypothesis: Risk assets rally on pivot hopes
details.actual_outcome: S&P rallied 14% Oct-Dec 2022 on peak inflation narrative. Fed did slow to 50bp Dec, then 25bp.

details.title: Disinflation Takes Hold — CPI Falls to 3%
details.expected_narrative: Disinflation Trend — headline CPI collapsing, core sticky
expected_hypothesis: Headline disinflation real but core stubborn
details.actual_outcome: Continued disinflation through 2023. S&P rallied 24% for full year. Fed held rates at 5.25-5.5%.

details.title: Sticky Core — Services Inflation Persists
details.expected_narrative: Sticky Services — shelter inflation keeping core elevated, delaying cuts
expected_hypothesis: Rate cuts delayed but still coming
details.actual_outcome: Rate cut expectations pushed from March to September. S&P still rallied on AI enthusiasm.

details.title: Fed Begins Hiking Cycle — First 25bp Hike
details.expected_narrative: Late to Act — Fed behind the curve, inflation embedded
expected_hypothesis: Dot plot will shift dramatically higher
details.actual_outcome: Fed hiked 425bp total in 2022, fastest pace since 1980s. Dot plot rose to 5.1% terminal.

details.title: Powell Pivot — 'A Long Way from Neutral' to Patient
details.expected_narrative: Powell Pivot — Fed capitulates on tightening, signals patience
details.actual_outcome: S&P rallied 28% in 2019 after Powell pivot. Fed cut rates 3 times in 2019.

details.title: Fed Cuts 50bp — First Cut Since 2020
details.expected_narrative: Jumbo Cut — Fed goes big to front-load easing, soft landing signal
details.actual_outcome: S&P hit all-time highs post-cut. Fed cut another 25bp in November and December 2024.

details.title: First Rate Hike After Zero — Liftoff
details.expected_narrative: Liftoff — historic first hike in 7 years, fragile markets
details.actual_outcome: S&P was flat for 2015-2016. Dollar surged 25% over two years. EM sell-off in early 2016.

details.title: SVB Collapse — US Regional Banking Crisis
details.expected_narrative: Banking Panic — SVB/Signature/First Republic failures, systemic risk
details.actual_outcome: BTFP facility stabilized banks. Regional bank index never fully recovered. Credit tightened. No recession followed.

details.title: COVID Crash — Fastest Bear Market in History
details.expected_narrative: COVID Crash — pandemic-induced recession, unprecedented policy response
details.actual_outcome: S&P fell 34% in 23 trading days. Then rallied 68% in 2020. Historic V-shaped recovery.

details.title: UK Gilt Crisis — LDI Meltdown
details.expected_narrative: UK Fiscal Crisis — Truss mini-budget triggers LDI doom loop, BoE intervenes
details.actual_outcome: BoE intervention stabilized markets. Truss resigned after 44 days. GBP recovered to 1.20+.

details.title: Soft Landing — GDP 4.9% Q3 Amid Tightening
details.expected_narrative: Defying Gravity — US economy accelerates despite 525bp of hikes
details.actual_outcome: No recession in 2024. GDP grew 2.8% in 2024. Soft landing achieved.

details.title: Technical Recession — Two Negative GDP Quarters
details.expected_narrative: Technical Recession — two negative quarters but labor market strong
details.actual_outcome: Not declared recession. Labor market remained strong with 3.5% unemployment.

details.title: King Dollar — DXY Hits 114, 20-Year High
details.expected_narrative: King Dollar — aggressive Fed + global slowdown = dollar strength tsunami
details.actual_outcome: DXY peaked at 114.8 in Sept 2022. Fell to 101 by Jan 2023. BOJ intervened in Oct 2022.

details.title: Dollar Weakness — DXY Falls Below 101 Ahead of Fed Cut
details.expected_narrative: Dollar Decline — rate cuts + growth convergence = weaker dollar
details.actual_outcome: DXY fell to 99.5 in Sept 2024. EM stocks outperformed. Gold hit all-time high $2600+.

details.title: Credit Spreads Widen — HY Spread Hits 550bp
details.expected_narrative: Credit Stress — recession fears driving spreads wider
expected_hypothesis: Spreads will normalize after inflation peak
details.actual_outcome: Spreads tightened sharply from Oct 2022 to Feb 2023. HY spread fell to 380bp.

details.title: NVIDIA Blowout — $22B Revenue, AI Capex Inflection
details.expected_narrative: AI Supercycle — NVIDIA earnings confirm capex inflection, AI is real
expected_hypothesis: AI capex has years to run
details.actual_outcome: NVDA rallied 170% in 2024. SMH +40%. AI capex continued accelerating into 2025.

details.title: DeepSeek Shock — Chinese AI Lab Claims US-Level Performance at Fraction of Cost
details.expected_narrative: AI Efficiency Shock — DeepSeek challenges GPU-intensive paradigm, capex sustainability questioned
expected_hypothesis: GPU demand may not be linear
details.actual_outcome: NVDA fell 17% in one day. Recovered within weeks. Capex continued rising. Jevons paradox applied.

details.title: Liberation Day — US Announces Sweeping Tariffs
details.expected_narrative: Trade War 2.0 — sweeping tariffs threaten global growth, stagflation risk
details.actual_outcome: S&P fell ~10% in April. Trade negotiations began. Tariffs partially rolled back.

details.title: Oil Crash — WTI Falls from $107 to $44
details.expected_narrative: Disinflation/Deflation Fears — oil crash threatens inflation expectations
details.actual_outcome: Fed delayed liftoff from June to December 2015. Core inflation remained 2%.

details.title: Gold Peaks at $1,900 — Inflation Hedge Mania
details.expected_narrative: Inflation Fears — gold at record highs on QE-driven inflation expectations
details.actual_outcome: Gold fell 30% over the next 2 years. Inflation averaged 1.6%. Fear was overblown.

details.title: Powell at Brookings — Signals Step Down to 50bp
details.expected_narrative: Pivot Signal — Powell confirms slowing pace, market euphoria
details.actual_outcome: S&P rallied 8% in a single day. Continued rallying into Q1 2023.

details.title: Lehman Collapse — Global Financial Crisis Peak
details.expected_narrative: GFC Peak — systemic collapse, unprecedented government intervention
details.actual_outcome: S&P bottomed March 2009 at 666. But TARP was profitable. 10-year bull market followed.

details.title: US Debt Downgrade — S&P Strips AAA
details.expected_narrative: Fiscal Crisis — US loses AAA, paradoxically treasuries rally
details.actual_outcome: Treasuries rallied (flight to quality). S&P fell 19% then recovered within months.

details.title: Services Boom — ISM Services Hits 54.9, Manufacturing Contracting
details.expected_narrative: Two-Speed Economy — services strong, manufacturing weak, overall resilient
details.actual_outcome: GDP grew 4.9% in Q3 2023. Two-speed economy persisted through 2024.

details.title: Dollar Top — DXY Falls from 103, Trump Weak Dollar Rhetoric
details.expected_narrative: Dollar Peak — Trump administration favors weak dollar, Fed tightening priced in
details.actual_outcome: DXY fell from 103 to 88 by Jan 2018. EM stocks rallied 37% in 2017.

details.title: ChatGPT Moment — AI Hype Begins, NVIDIA Surges Past $1T
details.expected_narrative: AI Inflection — generative AI captures public imagination, capex cycle begins
expected_hypothesis: AI will drive multi-year tech cycle
details.actual_outcome: NVDA became $3T company by mid-2024. AI drove 70% of S&P 500 gains in 2023.

details.title: Trade War Begins — Trump Announces Steel/Aluminum Tariffs
details.expected_narrative: Trade War 1.0 — protectionism returns, global supply chain disruption risk
expected_hypothesis: Trade uncertainty to weigh on growth
Fed may be forced to cut
details.actual_outcome: Trade war escalated through 2019. S&P was flat in 2018. Fed cut 3 times in 2019 partially due to trade uncertainty.

details.title: Deflation Scare — 10Y Treasury Hits 1.37%
details.expected_narrative: Deflation Fears — oil crash + global slowdown = deflation risk
details.actual_outcome: Oil recovered to $50+. Inflation normalized. Fed hiked only once in 2016.

details.title: Transitory Is Dead — Powell Retires the Word
details.expected_narrative: Policy Shift — Fed admits inflation not transitory, accelerates taper
details.actual_outcome: Fed ended taper by March 2022. First hike March 2022. 425bp of hikes in 2022.

details.title: Average Inflation Targeting — Fed's Historic Framework Shift
details.expected_narrative: Dovish Shift — Fed commits to letting inflation run hot, zero rates for years
details.actual_outcome: Massive asset inflation followed. Inflation was 7% by end of 2021. S&P doubled from 2020 lows.

details.title: Pre-COVID Peak — S&P at All-Time High, Unemployment 3.5%
details.expected_narrative: Goldilocks — low unemployment, low inflation, low rates, high asset prices
details.actual_outcome: COVID crashed markets within 3 months. No one predicted pandemic. A lesson in tail risk.

details.title: Credit Freeze — HY Spread Blows Out to 1100 bp
details.expected_narrative: Credit Panic — historic spread widening, Fed forced to buy corporate bonds
details.actual_outcome: Fed SMCCF worked. HY spreads narrowed to 400bp by year-end. Historic credit rally.

details.title: China Devaluation Panic — Yuan Falls, Global Selloff
details.expected_narrative: China Panic — yuan devaluation triggers global growth fears
details.actual_outcome: S&P fell 11% in 6 weeks then recovered. China stimulated. EM stabilized.

details.title: Dollar Weakens — DXY Falls from 103 to 93 on Massive Stimulus
details.expected_narrative: Dollar Bear Market — massive fiscal + monetary expansion, reserve currency concerns
details.actual_outcome: DXY fell to 89 by Jan 2021. Gold broke $2000. EM stocks rallied strongly.

details.title: AI Capex Arms Race — Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Meta Spend $200B+
details.expected_narrative: Capex Supercycle — Big Tech spending $200B+ on AI infrastructure
details.actual_outcome: Capex continued accelerating into 2025. ROI scrutiny increased with DeepSeek event.

details.title: Dollar Surge — DXY Rallies 25% Over 6 Months
details.expected_narrative: Dollar Bull Run — Fed tapering while ECB eases, policy divergence drives dollar
details.actual_outcome: DXY hit 100 by March 2015. EM currencies fell sharply. Oil crashed from $107 to $44.

details.title: Trump 2.0 — Markets Price in Pro-Growth, Inflationary Policies
details.expected_narrative: Trump Trade 2.0 — growth optimism + inflation fears + stronger dollar
details.actual_outcome: S&P rallied post-election. Bond yields rose on fiscal concerns. Dollar strengthened.

details.title: AI Revenue Inflection — Microsoft Azure AI Revenue Surges
details.expected_narrative: AI Monetization — AI is generating real revenue, not just hype, enterprise adoption real
expected_hypothesis: AI will boost software sector revenue
details.actual_outcome: Microsoft reached $3T market cap. Enterprise AI spending continued accelerating through 2025.

details.title: Phase One Deal — US & China Agree to Trade Truce
details.expected_narrative: De-escalation — trade war pause reduces uncertainty, growth to recover
details.actual_outcome: Pre-COVID, markets rallied on de-escalation. Manufacturing was recovering before pandemic hit.

details.title: High Yield Crisis — Third Avenue Blocks Redemptions
details.expected_narrative: Credit Stress — energy sector distress spills into HY market, liquidity concerns
details.actual_outcome: HY spreads peaked at 850bp in Feb 2016, then normalized. Fed hiked only once in 2016.

details.title: Taper Tantrum — 10Y Yield Surges from 1.6% to 2.7%
details.expected_narrative: Taper Tantrum — market panics at prospect of QE reduction, EM vulnerable
expected_hypothesis: EM at risk of capital outflows
details.actual_outcome: EM currencies and stocks sold off sharply. India, Brazil, Turkey hit hard. Fed didn't actually taper until Dec 2013.

details.title: Stargate — $500B AI Infrastructure Initiative Announced
details.expected_narrative: AI Manhattan Project — $500B infrastructure buildout signals government-level commitment
details.actual_outcome: Markets reacted positively. AI infrastructure spending expectations increased across the sector.

details.title: Dollar Spike — Global Dash for Dollars in GFC
details.expected_narrative: Dollar Squeeze — global dollar shortage, Fed forced to provide swap lines
details.actual_outcome: Swap lines stabilized dollar funding. DXY peaked at 89 then fell to 74 by 2011. EM recovered.
